sloka: सुह्R^दाम् नन्दनम् दीर्घम् सागरान्तव्यपाश्रयम् ।अस्यता च पुनः सव्यम् ज्याघातविगतत्वचम् ।दक्षिणो कक्षिणम् बहुम् महापरिघसम्निभम् ॥६-२१-७॥।।
transliteration: suhR^dām nandanam dīrgham sāgarāntavyapāśrayam ।asyatā ca punaḥ savyam jyāghātavigatatvacam ।dakṣiṇo kakṣiṇam bahum mahāparighasamnibham ॥6-21-7॥।।

translations.english: The mighty armed Rama's arms were hardened like that of iron bars by the large number of arrows received by the left arm and strained by giving thousands of cows as gifts by the right arm. Rama was determined now to cross over the great ocean or meet the sea with death and lay down subdued and restrained like a sage.
translations.hindi: ओर जो बाँया हाथ बाण छोड़ने के कारण प्रत्यरा के. आघात चिह्न से चिहित हो रहा है और जो दहिनी. भुजा बड़े: परिघ फे समान है
